collections.name: Singhasan Battisi
collections.research_gaps: The 32 tales are not indexed. Edition records exist on the Internet Archive (catalogue metadata only, not contents): A. Sutton, The Batrish Singhasan or Tales of the Thirty-two Images, Orissa Mission Press, Cuttack, 1840 (dli.ministry.27970); Singhasan Bateesi 1884 (dli.ernet.435184); Brijballabh Hariprasad Ji, Singhasan Battisi, 1920 (in.ernet.dli.2015.484231). Their text files sit on archive.org file servers this environment cannot reach, so no tale list was read and no tale is verified.
collections.remaining_work: Fetch and parse an edition index for every gap above; verify each seed entry against it; add variants and alternate titles.

collections.name: Akbar and Birbal
collections.research_gaps: The tradition is oral and anecdotal. Wikisource holds no edition; the Internet Archive lists only a Gujarati Birbal Vinod (dli.ernet.516959, no author or date) and 1939 Bangali Birbal (a different subject), with no readable contents, so no individual tale can be verified.
collections.remaining_work: Fetch and parse an edition index for every gap above; verify each seed entry against it; add variants and alternate titles.
